prompt: I want to document the decision to go with a monorepo structure for our new platform. We considered a polyrepo approach and a monorepo using Turborepo. Key drivers were: developer experience (easy to make cross-package changes), CI speed, and how easy it is to onboard new engineers. We went with Turborepo monorepo because cross-package refactors are way easier and new engineers only need to clone one repo. Downside is CI caching is more complex and the repo will grow large over time.

assertions.description: File has YAML frontmatter with title, adr, status, date, authors, and changelog fields
Document contains Motivation, Decision Drivers, Options, and Decision sections
Each option lists pros and cons referencing the same named decision drivers
Document includes a Consequences section with at least one good and one bad consequence
ADR file is at docs/adrs/NNNN-*.md with zero-padded number and kebab-case name
docs/adrs/README.md exists and contains a table entry linking to the new ADR
Options section contains at least one specific current fact (version number, release date, adoption data, or recent feature note) that goes beyond the user's original description
